title: Navratri Bhakti Parva (Mahila Event)
description: Navratri is a nine-night festival celebrating the divine feminine power (Shakti).
long_description:
Navratri is a nine-night festival celebrating the divine feminine power (Shakti). Join the community for traditional Garba and Dandiya Raas dances, devotional music, cultural programs, and festive food. A joyful celebration of music, dance, and devotion.

This celebration takes place at BAPS Sacramento in Sacramento, CA. All are welcome.
